comment: This file contains examples of how you can use Smashable Blocks to make certain blocks fragile.
Don't make behaviours that affect blocks that are super-common in the world e.g. stone or dirt or you can quickly ruin your terrain!
This object will make vanilla and modded glass panes breakable using NeoForge's c tag.
This one makes full glass blocks harder to break, and only breakable by 'heavy' things like players, not 'light' things like arrows.
This one does the same for glowstone blocks.
